premises.text: Integrating the house key into the smartphone enables a new access-sharing experience

premises.text: Multifamily entry requires controlling both the front door and the apartment door
premises.evidence_span: you have two doors, the front and the apartment door to pass when you want to enter

premises.text: Intercom chip plus apartment lock hardware is plug-and-play and leaves the downstairs door unchanged
premises.evidence_span: there's no changes at the front door downstairs

premises.text: Digital keys can be pre-shared, set temporary, removed anytime, and paired with access monitoring
premises.evidence_span: you can monitor your doors, who accessed when. And of course, you can share keys with your friends, guests

premises.text: Hardware-plus-software package includes brand-partnered lock security

premises.text: Users retain regular keys or PIN if the phone fails

value.text: Personal always-on digital doorman for remote unlock and guest access
